Usage: droid exec [options] [prompt]

Execute a single command (non-interactive mode)

Arguments:
  prompt                      The prompt to execute

Options:
  -o, --output-format <format>  Output format (default: "text")
  --auto <level>              Autonomy level: low|medium|high
  --skip-permissions-unsafe   Skip ALL permission checks - allows all permissions (unsafe)
  -m, --model <id>            Model ID to use (default: gpt-5.6-sol)
  -r, --reasoning-effort <level>  Reasoning effort (defaults per model)
  --use-spec                  Start in spec mode
  -h, --help                  display help for command

Autonomy Levels:
  Droid exec uses a tiered autonomy system to control what operations the agent can perform.

  DEFAULT (no flags)         Read-only mode - The safest mode for reviewing planned changes without execution
                             • Reading files or logs: cat, less, head, tail, systemctl status

  --auto low                 Low-risk operations - Basic file operations while blocking system changes

Available Models:
  auto                          Auto Model
  claude-opus-5                 Opus 5
  claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929    Sonnet 4.5
  gpt-5.6-sol                   GPT-5.6 Sol (default)
  gemini-3.1-pro-preview        Gemini 3.1 Pro
  glm-5.3                       GLM-5.3 (Droid Core)
  minimax-m2.7                  MiniMax M2.7 (Droid Core) [Deprecated]

Custom Models:
  custom:Example-Model-[BYOK]-0  Example Model [BYOK]

Model details:
  - Auto Model: supports reasoning: No; supported: [none]; default: none
  - Opus 5: supports reasoning: Yes; supported: [off, low, medium, high, xhigh, max]; default: high
  - GPT-5.6 Sol: supports reasoning: Yes; supported: [none, low, medium, high, xhigh, max]; default: medium

Authentication:
  Create an API key: https://app.factory.ai/settings/api-keys
